blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine National Police (PNP) is targeting to arrest the remaining estimated 300,000 wanted persons nationwide as it seeks to clear its backlog following the apprehension of some 200,000 fugitives in the past 14 months. In a statement on Tuesday, the PNP said it intends to reduce the estimated 300,000 remaining wanted persons in its database to zero by stepping up operations, intelligence gathering, and coordination with other law enforcement agencies. “We will not be satisfied with reducing the backlog since our ultimate objective is to bring it down to zero,” said PNP chief Gen.
